entry.name: jit.gl.node
entry.description: Use jit.gl.node to construct hierarchical rendering groups. jit.gl.node creates sub-contexts of child objects that can be modified, rendered, and captured together as a functional group.

attributes.digest: Adapt texture dims to window size
attributes.description: Adapt the capture texture dimensions to the context window size (default = 1).

attributes.name: capture
attributes.digest: Capture to internal texture
attributes.description: Capture to the internal texture (default = 0).Possible Values:0 = disabled. Rendering is performed according to the parent context, which can be another jit.gl.node or a jit.gl.render object.1 = enabled. Rendering is captured to a texture and the texture name is output out the left outlet.> 1 = outputs multiple render targets (mrt) to the left outlet in the format "".
